name: PyPI — requests package metadata (version, requires-python)
goal:
Open https://pypi.org/project/requests/ (the PyPI page for the 'requests' package) and extract:
  1. The package name
  2. The latest version shown in the page header (e.g. '2.32.3')
  3. The 'Requires: Python' specifier shown in the Meta section (e.g. '>=3.9')

Return ONLY a JSON object with EXACTLY these three keys:
  - "name": the package name (string, e.g. "requests")
  - "latest_version": the version string (e.g. "2.32.3", NOT a number)
  - "requires_python": the Python version specifier string (e.g. ">=3.9")

Example correct output (values will differ for the current page):
  {"name": "requests", "latest_version": "2.32.3", "requires_python": ">=3.9"}

Do not include any extra fields. Complete with EXACTLY this JSON object as your final result.
